content: Hello, I hope to get a room for the night.
Let me see if I can fit you in. What kind of room do you want?
I only need a single room.
You are in luck, we have one free.
I am very grateful. How much will it be?
That will be 600 RIB. Could I have your credit card please?
Oh dear. I don't have it with me. Do you take debit cards or should I pay with cash?
A debit card will be fine.
